### Notes

Age cap and incorporation requirement confirmed on the FAQ page (https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/startups/faq/): "Members must employ at least one developer, maintain a working website, be officially incorporated, and be less than 10 years old." Excluded categories are listed there too. The page states revenue is not required; it makes no affirmative statement about funding being required or not, so funding gates are left unknown. No dollar value is attached to the cloud credits anywhere on the page. Benefits quoted verbatim: "Members benefit from preferred pricing on a subset of our enterprise-grade GPUs." and "Access free cloud credits from NVIDIA and partners". Funding is not an eligibility condition - the FAQ states "Generating revenue isn't required for membership". Excluded: consulting and outsourced development firms, cryptocurrency companies, cloud service providers, resellers and distributors, public companies.
